_about: Every NASA dataset the game plans to use. Shown on the Science Sources screen (Step 8) and in README.md. endpoint_status: 'not checked' until Step 5 reads the official docs. Never add an endpoint that is not in official NASA docs.

sources.name: DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information)
sources.what: Real solar flares (FLR) and CMEs from the past.
sources.why: Gives each run a real flare date and size.
sources.game_moment: Solar flare day, Real Mission mode, end screen.

sources.name: APOD (Astronomy Picture of the Day)
sources.what: A real space photo with its title and credit.
sources.why: A real night sky for the opening scene.

sources.name: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR)
sources.what: Real research on astronauts and plants in space.
sources.why: Science findings for the debrief cards.
sources.game_moment: Debrief cards on plant and crew days.

sources.name: Mars environment values (sol length, temperature, dust)
sources.what: Real measured values from NASA Mars missions.
sources.why: Sets the sol length, cold nights and dust in the game.
sources.game_moment: Base sky, dust days, Day Report.
sources.endpoint_status: saved values only: no live public Mars weather API is known to be running

sources.name: Earth-Mars distance and signal delay
sources.what: How far Mars is today and how long a radio message takes.
sources.why: Sets the Ask Earth wait and the late-message day.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library
sources.why: Pictures for fact cards and the ending.
